candidate.description: Fence work-steal rejection responses by status

red.failure: The wrong-donor empty response consumed donor-a's pending shared-transfer reservation, so donor-a's later valid response was rejected.

green.coverage: 11 Heijunka scheduler tests and 17 work-stealing tests, including full 256 receipt capacity, 255 with two in-flight requests, response reservation matching, and shared-transfer-ID wrong-donor rejection.

toolchain.network: No package download or network access was used. Existing realized root dependency ebin inputs were reused.

preflight.reason: Inherited attempt 3 lease was expired and task selection was not eligible. The failed preflight is preserved; it did not authorize a claim.

claim.authority: Native Sa-plan adapter, explicitly authorized parent recovery instruction

implemented: Receiver reserves bounded accepted-plus-pending receipt capacity before issuing a fresh work-steal request.
A response adopts tasks only with an exact pending donor, recipient, and transfer identity.
TransferAccepted and TransferRejected are typed; a rejection cannot consume a pending reservation.
not_claimed: Physical network delivery, authentication, disk persistence, restart durability, formal refinement, integration, deployment, or EV admission.
